programme.title: China's Wild Secrets S1E4 -Siberian Tiger Country
programme.desc: This episode follows the stealthy movements of China's elusive, big cats. hunting strategies.

programme.title: The Leopardess S1E1 -Sudden Death

programme.title: 第1集 - 死神驟降
programme.desc: 塞倫蓋提北部的濱岸林是一片緊鄰著炙熱平原的多蔭灌叢, 為各種動物提供了多樣的生態棲位, 這裡也是一隻母花豹的地盤, 在牠的活動範圍裡, 可能幾天不見牠的蹤影, 接著又突然出現, 奪走獵物的生命。對某些森林動物來說, 牠的出現就像死神突然降臨, 牠來無影去無蹤, 是濱岸林的神秘天后。

programme.title: Just Animals S2E8 -Just Marsupials

programme.desc: Uncover mind-blowing tactics, ingenious team work and unrivalled speed, stamina, and stealth; revealing the most formidable hunters in the animal kingdom.

programme.desc: 卡悠提前往澳洲內陸, 尋找傳奇的眼斑巨蜥。

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet S4E6 -The Heart Of A Pit Bull

programme.title: 第6集 - 鬥牛犬動手術
programme.desc: 在今天的熱血獸醫院中, 傑夫要救治一隻吞了芒果核的狗高斯。高斯主人帶牠到醫院之前, 高斯已經連續嘔吐了二十五次。傑夫醫生為高斯觸診後, 發現牠的腹部有異物。在照X光確認有異物後, 傑夫便決定開刀取出。但他在開刀後發現, 異物已經到達結腸。結腸內的細菌很多, 如果開刀可能會造成腸胃道感染。因此傑夫決定將異物推擠出來。最後傑夫為高斯灌腸, 並在太太佩特拉的協助下, 取出高斯體內的芒果核。高斯在手術後一直不吃東西, 讓傑夫很擔心手術是否出了問題。但高斯一看到主人後, 就高興地吃起東西了。

programme.title: Life At The Limits S1E1 -Wet And Dry

programme.title: Anaconda (2025)
programme.desc: 這並非翻拍版本。本片是一部全新原創喜劇, 靈感源自「經典」電影《狂蟒之災》。故事講述自童年已是好友的德 (積伯克飾) 與基夫 (保羅活特飾) , 一直夢想重拍他們最喜愛的電影, 中年危機促使二人終於決定付諸行動, 深入亞馬遜叢林展開拍攝。然而, 一條真正的大蟒蛇出現, 使原本滑稽而混亂的片場瞬間變成奪命困境。他們拼命想拍成的電影, 或許真的要以性命為代價...

programme.title: Sight Unseen S2E1 -Runaway Bride
programme.desc: In the season premiere, Tess and Sunny join Jake to find the killer of an unknown bride found on a desolate beach in her wedding gown as they navigate whether they can still trust Lieutenant Bennett. Stakes rise as the bridal party's florist is found dead while our team discovers that the first victim and her grieving fiancee were once on opposite ends of the law... and running from a past that has finally caught up to them. Meanwhile, Sunny tries not to let on that she's still distraught after 110's home invasion. And Mia helps Tess find answers to a new facet of her sight loss.

programme.title: 第1集 - Runaway Bride
programme.desc: 在本季首播集中, 一個不知明新娘身穿婚紗, 在荒蕪的海灘上被發現身亡, 德絲與辛妮和積一同追尋兇手, 同時他們還在思考能否繼續信任貝列中尉。隨著供應婚禮派對用花的花店老闆死亡, 風險也隨之增加, 而團隊更發現第一位受害者及其悲痛中的未婚夫曾經犯法......並且正在逃避過去, 然而結果屬徒然。與此同時, 辛妮極力隱藏她在上一季結局中, 住所遭入侵後, 仍然極為焦慮。美婭助德絲找到解決喪失視力問題的新答案。

programme.title: Sight Unseen S2E2 -About A Boy

Tess and Jake race against the clock to bring the child home alive as Sunny pours all her focus away from her trauma and into the case. When Tess and Jake track down the perp in a tense OJ style pursuit, Tess's empathy defuses a potentially deadly standoff, reuniting the boy safely with his family and prompting her to reflect on her own family history. Meanwhile, Sunny fights back intrusive thoughts with self-defense classes, and Matt seems to be ready to move on from Tess- but who is he dating...?

programme.title: The Big Experiment S1E1

programme.title: 第1集
programme.desc: 英國最熱忱的三名科學家, 離開實驗室六週, 到倫敦數一數二難搞的班級, 要讓學生體會到科學能改變自己的生活。化學家彼德在第一天的教學中, 使用教具讓學生認識原子的組成, 但是控制教室秩序卻成了他的惡夢。之後他們開始用各種活動和實驗吸引學生的注意力, 最後甚至帶他們到倫敦的色情蘇活區, 看霓虹燈, 討論元素遇電發出不同顏色的現象。最後學生們要用一整週學到的知識, 進行勁爆實驗, 在五種掩蔽中, 選擇一種遇到雷擊能讓人毫髮無損的遮蔽, 是否有學生能選對呢?

programme.title: How It's Made S12E25 -Wild West Holsters, Water Video Housings, Soy Drinks And Pet Nail Trimmers
programme.desc: On this episode of How It's Made: Wild West holsters, underwater video housings, soy beverages, and pet nail trimmers.

programme.title: 第25集 - 西部皮套
programme.desc: 本集中介紹四種發明, 第一是美國大西部年代常見的手槍皮套, 能隨身攜帶手槍和子彈。如今工匠可以製造好幾種來自該年代, 風格各異的槍套並且客製化, 以攜帶任何大小或形狀的武器。第二是讓攝影機能下水的外殼, 包含遠端攝影控制鈕與內建螢幕。按鈕都以Ｏ型環來防水, 更有翻轉濾鏡能抵銷深水對顏色的削減效應。第三是源於數百年前中國的豆漿, 現已經成為大受歡迎的牛奶替代品。豆漿由液化的大豆製成, 經過研磨、攪拌與或過濾等過程才得以裝盒上架。第四是寵物指甲刀, 因為貓狗有圓形指甲, 特製修剪工具能替牠們修剪出完美的指甲。截斷式指甲刀有個小洞能容納寵物的指甲以及剪掉指甲的滑動刀片, 讓寵物剪指甲的過程更為輕鬆。

programme.title: 第1集 - 日全蝕全記錄
programme.desc: 超級日全蝕在睽違99年後, 再次重返美國本土。民眾與天文學界摩拳擦掌、準備追蹤難得奇景。

programme.title: Mysteries Of The Missing S1E7 -The Men Who Beat Alcatraz
programme.desc: In 1962, three convicts attempt the impossible and escape from Alcatraz prison.

programme.title: 第7集 - 逃出惡魔島
programme.desc: 加州舊金山灣裡有個與世隔絕的小島叫阿卡特茲, 由於小島四周海域鯊魚密布, 舊金山灣經常激浪洶湧, 加上海水又終年酷寒, 因此島上就設立了一座全美最安全牢固的監獄, 裡面關著許多重刑犯, 這裡號稱是誰也逃不出去的監獄, 但是沒想到在１９６２年６月１１日的夜裡, 卻發生一樁震驚全美的越獄案, 三名囚犯趁著夜晚利用管道通路爬出監獄牢房進入海裡泳渡舊金山灣, 可是在冰冷的海裡要游２公里多的距離才能登上大陸, 要和洶湧的海流浪潮拚搏, 同時還要提防鯊魚攻擊, 重重險阻簡直比登天還難, 他們越獄成功的機率幾乎是微乎其微, 然而令人意外的是案發之後, 當局經過大規模搜索追緝, 卻始終不見這三名逃犯的蹤影, 舊金山灣裡也沒有他們的屍體, 他們彷彿就此人間蒸發, 這樁不可思議的越獄案, 歷時五十多年仍然是個大謎團, 如今科學家要利用全新科技, 就逃犯的逃亡過程進行實驗, 依當時的環境氣候地理海象等客觀因素, 參考逃犯自己的體能狀況, 看他們究竟是否真能逃出這座監獄島。

programme.title: Extraordinary Stories Behind Everyday Things S1E5 -Banjo Tile Baby Shoe
programme.desc: A manufacturer shows how to make a banjo from raw wood in Southern California. Plus, discover how dirt is transformed into hand-painted ceramic tiles.

programme.title: 第5集 - 斑鳩琴,磁磚,嬰兒鞋
programme.desc: 本集日用品傳奇介紹了三種歷久彌新的美國製產品。班鳩琴深具美式風味, 鉤扣、調音紐與音格等元素都由爵爾史偉尼發明, 在1840至1930年代盛極一時, 如今的工法則兼具產能與手工氣息。凱納史考公司是美國現存最老的童鞋廠, 於1960年代顛覆業界, 推出柔韌好穿的童鞋, 至今除了傳承工藝也持續研發。耐火黏土磁磚公司自草創起就關注環保議題, 積極回收利用巖場尾礦與舊瓷, 打造出亮麗且耐用千年的新瓷磚。

programme.title: Extraordinary Stories Behind Everyday Things S1E6 -Rocking Chair Roller Skates Pitcher
programme.desc: Discover how therapeutic rocking chairs are built in North Carolina and how a family-owned company in Minnesota has made roller skates since 1945.

programme.title: 第6集 - 搖椅,滑輪鞋,水罐
programme.desc: 本集日用品傳奇關注有益身心的美國製著名產品, 分別介紹莫希輪鞋、喜慶圓盤水瓶與卡羅來納搖椅。輪鞋在19世紀經美國發明家改良後, 發展成美國的全民休閒運動, 從幼兒到樂齡人士都能溜個暢快。圓盤水瓶的設計源自大蕭條時期, 多彩色調與裝飾藝術造型撫慰了許多人心。卡羅來納搖椅由於配重與工法適切, 曾是甘迺迪總統緩解背痛的必備良伴, 更毫無返廠維修的紀錄。

programme.title: Heavy Metal Task Force S2E6 -Hercules, Mt720 Roadheader And Slv100 Slag Hauler
programme.desc: The largest marine crane in Asia assembles oil rigs right in Singapore's harbor.

programme.title: 第6集 - Hercules, Mt720 Roadheader And Slv100 Slag Hauler
programme.desc: The largest marine crane in Asia assembles oil rigs right in Singapore's harbor.

programme.title: How The Universe Works S10E4 -Voyager's Ultimate Mission
programme.desc: The two Voyager spacecraft have travelled farther than any human-made object in history.

programme.title: 第4集 - 航海家號的最終任務
programme.desc: 航海家一號和航海家二號是有史以來最野心勃勃的太空任務, 它們於1977年發射, 目前已經航行了44年, 探索了許多以前從未到達過的地方。

programme.title: Unexplained And Unexplored S1E6 -Hunt For The Ark Of The Covenant
programme.desc: New clues taken from long-lost maps offer fresh leads in the hunt for the Ark of the Covenant, and using the latest hi-tech archaeological methods.

programme.title: 第6集 - 搜尋法櫃
programme.desc: 法櫃是所有冒險者夢想找到的東西, 所羅門王在耶路撒冷建造聖殿, 專門造來安置法櫃。法櫃在聖殿內被保存保護了幾百年, 直到巴比倫人攻陷耶路撒冷、洗劫聖殿, 法櫃從此在史上神秘消失。若法櫃逃過耶路撒冷的洗劫, 可能被帶到了埃及, 利用聖經世界的古老地圖中所隱藏的線索, 主持人追蹤到了南埃及, 一路到了尼羅河源頭, 衣索比亞高原不知名荒蕪之地的天空教堂, 在那裡, 他們找出法櫃新的可能隱藏處。

programme.title: Invent It Rich S2E6 -Disappearing Acts
programme.desc: Brook & Brian help Marc vet four big claims: a disappearing ink that allows paper to be reused; a remote control steering system for a jet ski.

programme.title: 第6集 - Disappearing Acts
programme.desc: 這次有四組自創者尋求風險投資家馬克波特尼的投資, 他們分別是強調自然醒的鬧鐘、一個人也能玩花式滑水的遙控滑水器, 還有會自動消失的印表機墨水, 可以讓紙張重複列印, 最後是消除馬桶臭味的除臭機。這四個產品在自我介紹後, 要經過布魯克德和布萊恩羅伊的實地測試, 再交給一般大眾做評估, 最後交給馬克做最後的決定。這次的四個產品表現都非常優秀, 在專家提出建議之後, 馬克先放棄藍色地球墨水和醒醒鬧鐘, 最後只剩下遙控滑水器和諾莫馬桶除臭器爭取馬克的資金。

programme.title: Great American Eclipse S1E1 -Countdown To Darkness
programme.desc: In 2017, a solar eclipse crossed the United States for the first time in 99 years. Cutting-edge NASA missions investigate this once-in-a-life-time event.

programme.title: When We Left Earth: The NASA Missions S1E4 -The Explorers
programme.desc: Now that NASA has successfully made the orbiting trip to the moon and back, it's time for the next step and explore the moon.

programme.title: 第4集 - 太空前哨站
programme.desc: 太空總署信心大增, 阿姆斯壯和艾德林試探性的腳步, 被查理杜克、約翰楊恩和金柯能等人後來居上, 他們搭著探月車在月球四處跑。登月任務變得更加雄心勃勃。

programme.title: Invent It Rich S2E6 -Disappearing Acts
programme.desc: Brook & Brian help Marc vet four big claims: a disappearing ink that allows paper to be reused; a remote control steering system for a jet ski.

programme.title: 第6集 - Disappearing Acts
programme.desc: 這次有四組自創者尋求風險投資家馬克波特尼的投資, 他們分別是強調自然醒的鬧鐘、一個人也能玩花式滑水的遙控滑水器, 還有會自動消失的印表機墨水, 可以讓紙張重複列印, 最後是消除馬桶臭味的除臭機。這四個產品在自我介紹後, 要經過布魯克德和布萊恩羅伊的實地測試, 再交給一般大眾做評估, 最後交給馬克做最後的決定。這次的四個產品表現都非常優秀, 在專家提出建議之後, 馬克先放棄藍色地球墨水和醒醒鬧鐘, 最後只剩下遙控滑水器和諾莫馬桶除臭器爭取馬克的資金。

programme.title: 第6集 - 冒險賭注
programme.desc: 鮑比和賈斯汀想買一輛新的維修卡車, 但他們希望卡車能有四輪驅動系統所以去賭城參觀工程展, 打算買一套四驅系統, 他們看了四驅系統, 決定第二天去試車。他們不在的時候, 伐木團隊達到了一週出一百車的目標, 於是吃大餐慶祝。主廚的大衛有鑑於波的遭遇, 決定多做一些健康料理, 但是大夥似乎不太領情, 鮑比安排醫療團隊到巴克地來幫大家體來, 結果發現幾乎每個人的健康都有問題。

programme.title: 第13集 - 回歸正統
programme.desc: 盧和傑瑞要整修一輛1973年的德托馬索黑豹超跑。

programme.title: 第14集 - 前身減重
programme.desc: 盧和傑瑞要在福克斯車身上改裝空心前端和空心K樑, 這樣可以讓車子重量減輕許多。

programme.title: 第6集 - 漫長另類之旅
programme.desc: 勞勃這次想弄來一輛此生未曾擁有過的車, 並將之改造成電動車, 於是找了一名二手車賣家買下, 過程中還展現了高人一等的談判技巧。

programme.title: 第16集 - 媽媽的野馬
programme.desc: 女子修車手們幫一名現役軍人媽媽改造野馬, 還請了主人的女兒們幫手, 示範一些簡單的改造。

programme.title: 第4集 - 亂草堆裡的龐帝克
programme.desc: 史帝夫馬納提這次來到南卡羅來納州的切斯尼, 造訪開業40餘年的維克經典汽車場。

programme.title: 第5集 - 前驅賽車
programme.desc: 費尼根、考頓和紐本這回比的賽車不同於以往。所謂下護板賽車是將前驅車的後輪胎替換成鋼製護板, 再開上柏油路面拖行, 除了火花四射, 失控甩尾打滑更是家常便飯。穩定駕馭本來就不容易, 更別說搞笑三人組素來愛改裝破車, 上場後會鬧出什麼怪事?

programme.title: 第4集 - 高空驚魂
programme.desc: 本集三名飛機追追追專家繼續各自任務。凱文雷西與他的新學生剛偷走一架一百萬美元的李爾噴射機, 但是在高空3048公尺引擎斷油了, 而且他們正衝進雷暴中, 他們要怎麼化險為夷?飛機收回幹員丹尼湯普森大翹班, 拋下肯凱吉, 去執行賞金獵人的任務, 使肯在執行危險任務, 面對前科累累的債務人時, 少了人身保護。麥克甘迺迪深入山中尋一架昂貴的水上飛機, 但是缺乏燃料以及可以安全降落的水面之下, 他要如何脫困?精采內容敬請收看本集飛機追追追。

programme.title: 第7集 - 衛士與烈馬
programme.desc: 萊恩想為在非洲長大的太太改裝一輛1991年出產的衛士。

programme.title: 第6集 - 稀有快背車下集
programme.desc: 65年新烤漆的野馬快背送回。這是他們這次全車翻新, 跳過托里諾眼鏡蛇和喀普里之後的第三選擇, 原本以為車況很好, 但車身漆面之下有生鏽, 最後只能追加預算, 後來又發現底盤被噴成七彩, 而皮包骨在重噴傳動軸時, 不小心把塗料沾到車身漆面, 又得要多花一筆錢, 糗的是依此車車色, 沒得局部重烤, 幾番波折下來, 野馬終於來到收尾, 而找上門的買家, 讓人萬萬沒想到。

While over 10 million Koreans travel abroad each year, the '2 Days and 1 Night' casts travel around Korea - to the mountains, farms, fishing villages, islands - where you can meet the welcoming smiles of our neighbors and the beautiful nature that cleanse our eyes.

programme.desc: ASEAN·Korea Music Festival is a public cultural diplomacy project that aims to expand cooperation between ASEAN and Korea and foster cultural exchange among young people across Asia through popular music.

programme.title: The Seasons E18
programme.desc: A music program featuring performances and candid conversations with a diverse range of artists to deliver deep musical resonance

programme.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany E25 -Chicken With Figs
programme.desc: Rachael is joined by husband John, as she shows how to prepare a chicken and fig dish, featured on their wedding menu. Meanwhile, Rachael's sister Maria makes a one-bowl carrot cake.

programme.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany E26 -Pesto 2.0
programme.desc: Rachael is known for her delicious and flavourful pesto sauces of all varieties. She prepares a pesto alla trapanese, a Sicilian dish made with almonds and tomatoes.

programme.title: A Roommate To Die For
programme.desc: After a nasty breakup, Faith needs a new roommate to pay for the home. The new renter seems great until Faith finds that something very strange is going on.

programme.title: Secret Love Triangle
programme.desc: After being falsely charged with murdering her best friend's husband, Jessica goes on the run with her husband. To prove her innocence, she must first untangle a deadly web of lust and deceit.

programme.title: Zombie House Flipping S6E93 -Tampa: 58Th Avenue
programme.desc: The zombie team has their work cut out for them when they discover a 3bed/2bath might be missing a bedroom! Termites, collapsing ceilings and some surprises might just be a budget-buster!

programme.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes E7
programme.desc: Pantoh is a Taiwanese dining experience where guests enjoy exquisite dishes in open-air venues. Chef Ah-yong showcases an emblematic dish of pantoh cuisine: calamari, sea snail, and leek soup.

programme.title: Masterchef Australia S18E26
programme.desc: As perfect pairs week continues, contestants must work together to create four servings of a dessert inspired by the iconic Reese's Peanut Butter Cup.

programme.title: Masterchef Australia S18E27
programme.desc: In today's episode of MasterChef Australia, five cooks in the bottom are facing a Time VS Ingredients elimination challenge and the bottom dish will send its maker home.

programme.title: Masterchef Australia S18E28
programme.desc: Curtis Stone kicks off Aussie Classics week, with a once-in-a-lifetime chance for the cooks to have their dish stocked in Coles, as they are challenged to whip up nostalgic Pie and Ice-cream flavours.

programme.title: Masterchef Australia S18E29
programme.desc: With Curtis Stone back in the kitchen, and the MasterChef contestants are challenged with cooking a dish that heroes pork to save their place in the competition.

programme.title: Masterchef Australia S18E30
programme.desc: It's Aussie Classics Week, and there's nothing Aussies love more than a great comeback story. Today, the previously eliminated contestants return for a chance to earn their place back in the competition.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out S2E10 -Retraining The Brain
programme.desc: Dr. Lee's occupational therapist arrives to help re-train her body post-stroke. Medical patient Justin arrives with a body-covering, angry rash that is creating a wedge between him and his girlfriend.

programme.title: Abducted At An Hbcu: A Black Girl Missing Movie
programme.desc: When ambitious college student Shannon disappears due to financial struggles, her counselor Ellen discovers a trafficking ring targeting students like her and must fight to rescue Shannon.

programme.title: Murder At The Derby
programme.desc: Kara lands her dream job of working at a prestigious horse stable under the tutelage of Jennifer. As their relationship with develops, tensions grow with Jennifer's jealous brother, Stephen.

programme.title: Uptown Otters S1E3 -A Busy Bay
programme.desc: Get ready to rumble in Marina Bay, where the Nomads and Townies are squatting while Anna and the Bay Family are away upriver. Soak up the peaceful otter life in this luxurious waterway before the surprise early return of its rightful owners.

programme.title: Uptown Otters S1E4 -Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Welcome Anna’s clan back to Marina Bay, where two otter families have been trespassing. Feel the heat when Mia catches Anna’s scent and hustles the Townies out of reach. Then hold tight as the Nomads remain blissfully unaware of the coming conflict.

programme.title: Uptown Otters S1E5 -Battle for the Bay
programme.desc: Follow the Bay Family’s matriarch as she chases the Nomads out of her territory for good, and examine the surprising birthing den where the Townies’ leader, Mia, settles in. Then kick back with the Mangrove Family as they pal around with stray dogs.

programme.title: Uptown Otters S1E6 -Queen of the Bay
programme.desc: Chase Anna to the Townies’ lair, where Mia and her newborn pups are hiding out. See the babies’ first swimming lessons before the clan moves to new digs, and welcome an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a park’s main attraction.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It’s a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programme.title: Osprey: Sea Raptor
programme.desc: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys who’ve been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

programme.title: Stormborn S1E1 -Out of the Darkness
programme.desc: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

programme.title: Stormborn S1E2 -Return of the Light
programme.desc: Experience the north Atlantic’s intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

programme.title: Stormborn S1E3 -Children of the Storm
programme.desc: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia S1E1 -Tropical Shores
programme.desc: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia S1E2 -The Cool South
programme.desc: Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters. Come face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish, and huge blue whales; play with penguins and sea lions; and learn why these seas are brimming with life.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2E1 -Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2E2 -Double Trouble
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2E3 -Duck for Cover
programme.desc: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard that’s chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2E4 -Tangled Terror
programme.desc: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S2E4 -Brisbane Raid
programme.desc: Chase the team as they triage patients from a hoarding case, then free a tangled-up ibis with rescue officers Jo and Chantelle. Check on a baby koala that took a swan dive with vet Mel and play the waiting game with a deadly eastern brown snake.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S2E5 -Duckling Dramas
programme.desc: Deal with duelling duckling roundups and find out if vet Karina calls in specialists to treat koala Spike’s leg fracture. Get to the bottom of stomach issues plaguing baby echidnas Ping and Pong, and meet koala Jarrah, who seems to have lost his way.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S2E6 -Into the Sunset
programme.desc: Contend with a flood of abandoned koala joeys, then join vet nurse Nick on a hunt for natural remedies to treat a wallaby’s gut ailment. Ponder options for a baby bat stuck in a tree and look on as vet Karina operates on a barn owl’s fractured wing.

programme.title: Dance Party S2E1 -Learn & Dance with JJ's Animal Pals!
programme.desc: It's a learning dance party with JJ's animal pals! First, learn all about vowels with the fun & silly song 'Apples & Bananas.' Then, get ready to count as you dance with dinosaurs & countdown from five to one. The learning continues as you guess what sounds different animals make & bounce like rabbits, frogs & kangaroos on a trampoline! Plus, you can even learn to sing 'Itsy Bitsy Spider' entirely in Spanish with Nina!

programme.title: Go Buster S3E2 -Learning How to Be a Good Friend!
programme.desc: Join Buster as he learns how to be a good friend! When a new, shy student named Ash the firetruck joins the school, Buster sees he's all alone & invites him to play. Then, Buster learns another important lesson when he starts to lose a game of snakes & ladders & decides to cheat. From learning that sports aren't all about winning to standing up for his friends during a sleepover, Buster is on his way to being the best friend ever!

programme.title: Go Buster S3E1 -Our Favorite Family Adventures!
programme.desc: Join Buster on his favorite family adventures! When Mummy has to dash off to work, Buster & Grandpa have to make dinner together. They follow a recipe & it creates a big mess, but it's still tasty! The adventures continue as Buster & Daddy spend the day together, playing soccer & chasing a runaway kite! Plus, the whole family goes on an outdoor camping trip where a runaway tent causes chaos through the campsite.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage S7E1 -From Waterfalls to Outer Space!
programme.desc: Join Gecko on his biggest adventures yet, from waterfalls to outer space! First, when Grandma's caravan rolls into a river & heads for a waterfall, Gecko must perform a daring chase to save her! Then, a lovely day at the beach becomes perilous when some vehicles get caught in the tide, requiring a helicopter rescue. The adventure blasts off as the Mechs accidentally launch their homemade spaceship to the moon & need to use solar power to get home!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage S6E2 -A Big Test of Skill & Teamwork!
programme.desc: Gecko & the Mechanicals face a big test of skill & teamwork! First, the Mechs are in Garage School when a real emergency comes in. In a role reversal, they must fix Fiona the Firetruck's starter motor while Gecko instructs them! Then, when Blue crashes during a flying race, Gecko must show his skill to repair him. The day ends with a big American football game where Gecko comes up with a clever strategy & a creative fix to help his team win!

programme.title: ARPO S1E2 -Causing Chaos All Over Town!
programme.desc: Arpo & Baby Daniel are causing chaos all over town! The adventure starts at the supermarket when Daniel runs off with a giant lollipop, leading to a wild chase with Arpo's rockets on the fritz. Then, a relaxing fishing picnic turns into a wilderness survival test when a thieving squirrel tries to steal their food! Plus, the family gets a mischievous new puppy that Arpo has to keep from making messes & a stroller goes on the loose, forcing Arpo to chase it through town!

programme.title: ARPO S2E1 -Squirrel Trouble & Other Wacky Problems!
programme.desc: Arpo is dealing with squirrel trouble & other wacky problems! That pesky squirrel is always trying to steal food or run off with Baby Daniel's teddy bear. But the wacky problems don't stop there! When a ghost crashes playtime, Arpo has to use all his tech to bust it. Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire, like when a toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably & when Baby Daniel accidentally terrorizes him with a magnet. It's a day of very wacky problems!

programme.title: ARPO S3E2 -The Ultimate Arpo vs Squirrel Showdown!
programme.desc: It's the ultimate showdown between Arpo & his arch-nemesis, the Squirrel! The trouble multiplies when the squirrel uses a ray gun to create an army of clones that fills the house. Then, the battle for food continues as the squirrel tries to steal a freshly baked apple pie & tasty food from a picnic BBQ. The showdown gets truly bizarre when the squirrel gets trapped inside Arpo & takes control of the robot's body, causing all sorts of confusing chaos for the family!

programme.title: ARPO S4E1 -Crazy Competitions & Robot Malfunctions!
programme.desc: It's a day of crazy competitions & robot malfunctions! First, a friendly competition in the park turns into a wild go-kart race between Arpo & his rival, Nannybot! Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire. A toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably all over the backyard, & a malfunctioning birthday present massage chair chases him & Daniel around the house! From boomerang target practice to a building block showdown, the chaos never stops!

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time S1E2 -A Big Imagination Adventure!
programme.desc: Join JJ & his animal friends on a big imagination adventure! First, Wally teaches everyone how to sail like real pirates, but they'll need to work together to stay on course! Then, when Mimi gets hungry, she decides the moon must be made of cheese, so the friends build a rocketship to fly there & find out! The adventure continues as they follow a treasure map to find special shape keys & help Little Red Riding JJ avoid Wally Wolf's silly traps in the woods.

programme.title: Dance Party S1E5 -JJ's Big 'On The Move' Dance Party!
programme.desc: Get ready for a dance party that's always on the move! Join JJ, Cody & Nina as they groove to 'Wheels on the Bus' while a real bus travels in the background. Then, it's time to line up & pretend to be a train, chugging along to the 'Train Song'! The adventure continues as the kids put on their fire hats & sing about being brave firefighters with a big red firetruck. From the 'Animal Song' to seeing vehicles on the street, it's a high-energy dance party!

programme.title: Little Angel S2E10 -Baby John's Artsy August Tracks
programme.desc: Design your own racetrack this Artsy August! Use building blocks to create wild courses for your toy cars. Then, get your face painted like your favorite animal and help the family build a super cool treehouse together!

programme.title: Little Angel S1E8 -Baby John's August Art Box
programme.desc: Get crafty for Artsy August! Dig into Baby John's craft box and make a whole family of finger puppets. Then, play a fun color-matching game with a new train, count magical potatoes, and have a bubbly, colorful bath time adventure!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures S1E1 -High-Flying Fun!
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, & learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok & the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, & discovery.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders S2E2 -How Awesome Things Work!
programme.desc: Blippi wants to find out how awesome things work! He & D.BO visit a construction site where they learn all about safety & how a crane works. Then, they meet Frankie the Firetruck to see all of her amazing fire-fighting abilities in action! After that, it's time for some speed as they meet an F1 race car & a giant monster truck to learn what makes them so special. Finally, Blippi shrinks down to see how a guitar makes beautiful music!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders S1E4 -Answering Big Questions!
programme.desc: Blippi is answering some of life's biggest questions! He shrinks down for a night adventure in a mouth to learn the right way to brush teeth from Bill Brushy. Then, he flies up a nose to find out what makes us sneeze! His curiosity continues as he learns how a fly can walk upside down on the ceiling, discovers the artistic process of how spiders make their webs & even becomes a contestant on a game show to learn the difference between fruits & vegetables!

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm S2E2 -Let's All Help Each Other!
programme.desc: It's a day of helping each other at Lellobee City Farm! When a mama songbird's eggs are about to hatch, Mei, Ella & Rishi build her a beautiful bird feeding table so she can take care of her new chicks. Then, when Heidi the Horse is feeling down in the dumps, Ella & all the friends put on a show & give her a big group hug to make her feel happy again! The helping continues as everyone learns the importance of sharing their veggies with a visiting gopher.

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm S2E1 -Creative Farm Adventures!
programme.desc: Get ready for some creative farm adventures with Ella! First, Ella brings school to Lellobee City Farm by creating a classroom in the Boogie Barn & teaching all her animal friends. Then, she helps Mei make some delicious jam using fresh strawberries, grapes & blueberries from the farm! The creative day ends with a magical night of stargazing, where Mei points out constellations that look just like the animals on the farm.

programme.title: CoComelon S3E3 -How Does JJ Like to Play?
programme.desc: Find out all the fun ways JJ likes to play! First, join JJ, TomTom & YoYo as they spend the day indoors pretending to be doctors & nurses. Then, the fun continues outside! When the kids get restless at a family barbecue, they play a fun game of 'Simon Says.' On another adventure, experienced scouts TomTom & YoYo take JJ under their wing & show him how to do classic outdoor camping activities. From racing grocery carts to a doggy playdate, JJ loves to play!

programme.title: CoComelon S1E22 -JJ's Artsy August Class
programme.desc: Get creative for Artsy August! Join Ms. Appleberry's class to learn how red, blue, and yellow Jello can mix to make purple, orange, and green. Then, transform toy cars with a splash of paint and learn how to tap dance to the beat!

programme.title: CoComelon S3E2 -What Will JJ Learn Today?
programme.desc: What will JJ learn today? Join him for a week of fun as he learns why each day is special. Then, celebrate Valentine's Day with the Melon Patch kids as they show they care with gifts & kind words. The learning continues as Bella helps teach the class the ASL alphabet & Daniela teaches the differences between the English & Spanish ABCs! From visiting a petting zoo to learning about recycling, there's a new lesson every day!

programme.title: Cody Time S1E2 -Cody Is a Good Brother & a Good Friend
programme.desc: Join Cody as he learns how to be a good brother & a good friend! In a heartwarming moment, Cody finds out he's going to be a big brother. After some initial nerves, he spends a special day with his mama & her baby bump. Then, the big day arrives as the family brings his new sister, Kendi, home! Watch Cody take on his new role, helping Kendi get to sleep & learning to play new games together like bouncing a balloon.

programme.title: Morphle S4E1 -The Wacky World of Winston & Orphle!
programme.desc: Welcome to the wacky world of Winston & Orphle! First, Winston tricks a Magic Pet into growing his robots of Mila & Morphle big enough to steal the entire Magic Pet Center! Then, Orphle causes trouble on his own when he runs away with the cake Mila made for her & Morphle's Matchiversary. programme.title: Morphle S1E2 -The Most Unpredictable Magic Mishaps!

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Humor Research Institute
programme.desc: Hong Kong comedies from the 1980's and 1990's had been widely popular and many of them are still considered as classics among the genre. In this episode, the “Humor Research Institute” has invited veteran filmmakers Chan Hing Kai, Ho Miu Ki and Jack Ng to talk about their comedy-creating experience and introduce how fascinating comedies are written.

programme.title: Accident
programme.desc: A self-styled “accident choreographer,” the Brain is a professional hitman who kills his victims by trapping them in well crafted “accidents” that look like unfortunate mishaps but are in fact perfectly staged acts of crime. Perennially plagued with guilt, he is also suspicious and morbid by nature. The recent avalanche of memories of his lost wife does not make things any easier. After one mission accidentally goes wrong, causing the life of one of his men, the Brain is convinced that this accident has been choreographed: someone is out there plotting to terminate him and his team. He becomes increasingly paranoid, walking on the thin line between reality and delusion...

programme.title: Blue Giant
programme.desc: Miyamoto Dai, a student with a passion for basketball, has an overnight life-changing experience after going to a jazz show for the first time. As if hypnotised by this music he knows nothing about, the young man decides to devote himself heart and soul to the saxophone and jazz becomes his new passion. Will he succeed in becoming a great musician?

programme.title: The Narrow Road
programme.desc: Under this flashy city, amidst the numbness of frustrations, what people are looking forward to is the glimmer of light that might change their lives. Chak, who runs a small cleaning company, barely takes over the cleaning work on his own to make a living. Hitting by the COVID-19 pandemic, small business closed down one by one. One day, a young single mother, Candy, comes to look for a job opportunity from Chak. She doesn't seem like a trustworthy person to Chak, unexpectedly, she helps Chak to resolve many difficulties at work. Life seems like get back on track. The morning sun never lasts a day, Chak's company is being accused, at the same time, his family is facing a nightmare as well, all his hopes are dashed to pieces, but they can still try their best to resist the oppression of life and support each other through this painful year.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Together on the Narrow Path
programme.desc: Composer Wong Hin-yan won Hong Kong Film Awards and Golden Horse Awards' ‘Best Original Film Score' with The Narrow Road which was directed by his buddy Lam Sum. In this episode, the two will share about the correlation between soundtracks and visual images, and also look back on their paths from school to films.

programme.title: Perfect Wedding
programme.desc: One night, wedding planner - Yan met a young attorney, Fun and had a one-night stand. Later, Fung did accidentally join to Yan's wedding planning company. In a special wedding, regardless of Yan against Fung, the rigid procedures of the wedding ceremony turned into a warm, touching the carnival. Customers in more than touched, the two are deeply moved a step closer so emotional. However, the emotional harm suffered psychological Yan still cannot break the shackles of courage in the face of her girlfriends Fung's hand holding a bold recognition of this relationship. At this time, her fiance - Kelvin was again disrupted Yan's emotional world. Who is her true Love....?

programme.title: The Uniform
programme.desc: Set in 1997's Banqiao, Taiwan, the story explores the struggles and brilliance of a girl named Xiao Ai as she navigates her journey of growth. Originally accepted into her dream high school, Xiao Ai is compelled by her mother to transfer to the night school at Taipei First Girls' High School. Sharing desks with day students during the day, she forms a deep friendship with her 'desk mate,' Min Min. However, feeling inferior because of her identity as a night school student, she and Min Min both develop feelings for the gifted student, Luke. To conceal the truth, she dons the day school uniform and pretends to be the 'perfect girl' who matches Luke. The green uniform gives her confidence, but it also causes her lies to spiral out of control. On the day of the joint entrance exam, the truth is revealed, and Xiao Ai faces a heart-wrenching trial of growth amidst the storms of friendship, love, and family...

programme.title: Himalaya Singh
programme.desc: Singh is borne and grown up in Himalayas and has reached the ultimate stage in Yoga. He goes to participate the India Beauty's husband-to-be contest. He meets the wanna-be-married Tally. Tally proposed to induce Singh to be a rotten, so India Beauty has a bad husband. Uncle Panic goes traveling to India with his two nephews. Uncle Brave who is one of the tourists has absolutely opposite character. Uncle Panic bumps into several India robbers who hypnotize him and was brought into the Journey Of Illusion by The Peacock...

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Last Night Ever
programme.desc: In this episode, “Night King” Dayo Wong and Director Jack Ng reveal their personal experiences in nightclubs. While Dayo shares his 'bitterness' of being surrounded by the ladies and unveils the intricate storylines in the film, they also discuss about the differences between “Night King” and previous nightclub movies, allowing everyone to appreciate the film from various perspectives.

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News
programme.desc: Rita, 53, and her husband Siu Hung were planning their retirement when they suddenly discovered that they were pregnant! Both the couple wanted to have the child removed, but they didn't know how to tell each other. Until at a family dinner, two children accidentally discovered the secret of their mother, and the reaction was uproar. At the same time, Siu Hung's sister-Fuk Ling returned from abroad and decided to move in with everyone. The incompatible relationship between sister-in-law and sister-in-law suddenly plunged the Lee family into a chaotic dispute. In anger, Rita decided to become a senior mother and decided to give birth to the child in her belly. The peaceful and well-off family began an unprecedented 'big reform'. However, during this wonderful pregnancy process, everyone began to become different because of this sudden little life...including Fuk Ling, who had been married for many years but did not want to have children; his otaku son who was not good at expre

programme.title: Baogu Select Music X Microfilm E266 -Baby Gangster
programme.desc: An infant, adorned in golden jewelry, was abandoned in a garbage dump. Two mischievous boys found the baby, initially tempted by greed. However, the baby's cries stirred Lok's compassion, leading him to care for the child with all he had. Wai, on the other hand, stole all the gold and got rid of the infant. A mysterious cleaning lady appeared, returning the lost infant, leaving the gold turned into rocks. Despite losing the treasure, the two cared for the baby endured. Unable to provide a better life, they found the child a safer place with their bless.

programme.title: Memories
programme.desc: From the creative supervision of Katsuhiro OTOMO ('STEAMBOY', 'SHORT PEACE'), comes 'MEMORIES', a three-part work based on OTOMO's three original stories. ('MAGNETIC ROSE') Set in outer space at the end of the 21st century, the 1st part tells the story of two engineers who encounter the apparition of a female opera singer in an abandoned space freighter... ('STINK BOMB') The 2nd story is a satirical tale of a young lab technician who accidentally swallows experimental pills... ('CANNON FODDER') The 3rd part depicts war-time life in an imaginary world, using a characteristic camerawork.

programme.title: He Lives By Night
programme.desc: A cuckolded husband becomes a cross-dressing night stalker, compelled to strike down any women he sees wearing white fish-net stockings. Leaving a trail of dead bodies in his wake, he selects a female disc jockey as his next target...

programme.title: Kung Fu Vs Acrobatic
programme.desc: Two men fall journey into the far-reaches of China, but stumble upon a cave where Princess Wendy, her handmaid Mandy, and evil Tin have been in suspended animation for 800 years...

programme.title: Cop Of The Town
programme.desc: Bill and Lee are a pair of old hands working with the Action Squad in the Police Department. They both have their shortcomings. Bill likes to bet a bit to lighten up and Lee likes to flirt with pretty girls. But their little tales do not in anyway interfere with their dedication towards their work. Unfortunately for them, a Pl Mak is newly appointed as their squad leader. To make matter worse, the new inspector is female. Bill and Lee have to adjust in a hurry how the new inspector likes to handle cases her way...

programme.title: Perfect Exchange
programme.desc: Mindy is a top-notched gambler. During a card game, Mindy swindle millions of dollars, but they are caught. Lau makes a deal with Mindy that Mindy needs to go to prison...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Sandra Ng
programme.desc: Known as the 'Queen of Comedy', Sandra Ng as an actress has spanned across generations, allowing her to witness the ups and downs of Hong Kong films over decades. Looking back onto the golden age of Hong Kong cinema, Ng confessed that comedies in the old days were much more simple and straight forward. Stepping into the millennium, recession in film industry somehow inspired her to produce own masterpieces of the era. With her youth dedicated to the Hong Kong cinema, how does she feel about lifelong career as an actress, a director and a producer?

programme.title: Gambling Queen
programme.desc: Nan, a gambling goddess from Mainland China who is smart and has extraordinary martial arts skills. She comes to Hong Kong alone to find her cousin Bao who lives there. Her target: a crooked investor and card shark extraordinaire. When Nan's underhanded opponent proves too much to handle on her own, she enlists the aid of some rather unusual helpers, including an overconfident casino playboy, a disastrously awkward stuntman, and a perky martial arts princess. Pooling their various talents, Nan concocts a crazy scheme to take down her adversary that is destined to go down in gambling history.

programme.title: Running Out Of Time
programme.desc: Andy has only 14 days left in his life. He burglars a Diamond Trading Company and hence arouses the attention of a Police Negotiator, Sean...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Fully Funny - Eric Kot
programme.desc: Eric Kot's hilarious image has been widely recognized by Hong Kong audience on big-screen, particularly after portrayed the character of a zany assistant in ‘Tricky Business' and an attentive killer in ‘You Shoot, I Shoot'. Having years of acting experience, he has formed his own view of how to film a comedy. Apart from being in front of cameras, he had been invited by acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar-wai to participate his work at directorial role and encountered Asian star Takeshi Kaneshiro behind-the-scene. In this episode, Eric is going to tell his stories you might not know about.

programme.title: The Champions
programme.desc: Country boy Lee Tong has the knack of getting into trouble with great regularity. But this time, he has to beat it all the way to the city. And the first thing that happens to him in the city is to have his pocket picked. In chasing the thief, Lee meets young girl Fanny and knocks out No.1 ball player King by accident. Fanny and her brother Suen take Lee in. The two boys decide to adopt soccer as their profession. The ball club owned by King employs Lee only because King wants to settle the score with the boy. Lee Tong suffers all kinds of humiliations. Yet he presses on...

programme.title: Superstars Sunday: Easy Money
programme.desc: An armored car of the Royal Hong Kong Jockey Club transporting several million dollars is robbed by professionals from different countries hired by Michelle. The police put Senior Inspector King to be in charge of the case and Lam, the representative from the insurance company also joins the investigation...

programme.title: In Between Loves
programme.desc: Lung is a handsome young man. He has gift of the gab and is the best company to keep. Jane is a young talented reporter. She is devoted to her job. Lung and Jane seem to be ideally matched. But Jane, the famous TV reporter, has a lawyer boyfriend. And Lung is a mere taxi driver, just one of Jane's admirers. But Lung is determined to try. He gets to know Jane and gives her hot news tips. He organizes his cabbie friends into a radio news network, informing him all the happenings around the town. This works out at first, but sometimes they are led into ridiculous situation. Jane is slowly distancing herself form Lung. In desperation, Lung calls Jane saying he has the news of the century for her...

programme.title: Armour Of God II
programme.desc: Jackie the Condor is having his adventures, and Baron calls on him for help. Baron gives him an assistant Chinese scholar Ada, to locate and take back the gold hidden by the Nazis.

programme.title: Royal Rumours E2
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇。

programme.title: The Melody of You (Repackaged) E12 -全員溫情告別「音你之旅」
programme.desc: 五位全新的音樂人梁龍、胡夏、白舉綱、希林娜依·高、黃子弘凡以歌手形象反轉擔任Live House工作人員，以全新的姿態再度開啟這趟音樂旅程。同時，帶著全新口號「總有快樂發聲」，一起共同見證更多生活中的美好與驚喜。

programme.title: Treasure Creators Troupe E1 -解鎖文博新玩法
programme.desc: 邀請文博愛好者組成「文物代言人」，通過多元形式演繹國寶故事；以舞台創演、文創開發的創新形式，搭建起傳統文化與年輕群體的溝通橋樑，為文化傳承注入青春活力與澎湃動能。

programme.title: Perfect Match Season 16 E30 -探討戀愛裡的邊界感
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情。

programme.title: Love Never Comes Late Season 4 E69
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: Singing With Legends Season 6 (Repackaged) E6 -騰格爾張淇搖滾舞台好嗨
programme.desc: 節目煥新升級，打破原有賽制，以「聽世界的聲音，唱我們的歌」為主題，廣邀了劉宇寧、毛不易、馬嘉祺、古巨基、李克勤、騰格爾、龔琳娜等三十多位歌手平行演繹，回歸音樂本質，共同打造融合金曲，為歌手之間的合作與交流提供更多的可能性，打造充滿無限活力的音樂盛宴。

programme.title: Voices of Youth E10 -張新成鷺卓交流減肥經驗
programme.desc: 集結25位跨領域青春藝人，組建國內首個全明星流行表演合唱團「燃青團」；跳出傳統音樂真人秀的固化框架，不爭C位、不設淘汰，更關注合唱聲部，以團魂養成、情緒共振為核心，帶來全新觀看體驗；全景式記錄一群年輕人從陌生疏離到默契共生，從個體閃耀到集體綻放的熱血蛻變歷程。

programme.title: Perfect Match E5 -情歌暖男浪漫相親
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》全新改版，24位女嘉賓分為心動區和觀察區，男嘉賓暫不亮相，在「第二現場」與女嘉賓隔空對話。男女嘉賓通過雙向選擇，決定兩人能否成功牽手。

programme.title: Soda Master (Bilingual) E6
programme.desc: 三位51歲、對人生感到失意的中年大叔——吉井雄太、藤卷肇與菊原紀介，因故鄉傳來「工地挖出人骨」的新聞而重聚。他們原是少年時代的電影研究部夥伴，卻在回憶往昔時，驚覺他們的女顧問老師竟被標註為「行方不明」。這個發現，點燃了他們追查老師神祕失蹤真相的決心，也開啟了一段重新檢視自我與青春的救贖之旅。

programme.title: Where does the Sea Begin (Bilingual) E11
programme.desc: 大學時期的男主角月岡夏，與同學南雲水季交往起來，並過著幸福的日子。然而，正當他們都在忙著就業活動的時候，水季卻突然向他提出分手，從此兩人分道揚鑣。就這樣過了七年，已經開展新生活的夏，卻突然收到大學時代朋友的通知，原來水季已經離開了人世。從分手那天起就沒有再見過水季的夏，帶著難以置信的心情去參加了水季的葬禮。在葬禮上，夏見到了一個名叫海的小女孩，並得知她是水季和他的女兒，讓他感到十分震驚。原來當年水季竟瞞著他生下了他們的孩子，並且一直默默地撫養著這個孩子。知道這一切以後，夏開始思考水季和海在這七年間的生活。
